transcript: Speaker A: मैम प्लीज, मेरी वाइफ का ऑपरेशन अर्जेंट है, बहुत दर्द में है। [Ma'am please, my wife's operation is urgent, she is in a lot of pain.] Speaker B: सरनेम देखो, मिश्रा। इनके तो मंदिर में कनेक्शंस हैं ना? भगवान से करवा लो ठीक। लाइन में वेट करो। [Look at the surname, Mishra. They have connections in temples, right? Get it cured by God. Wait in line.] Speaker A: मैम ये हॉस्पिटल है, यहाँ कास्ट नहीं, कंडीशन देखते हैं। [Ma'am, this is a hospital, here we look at the condition, not the caste.] Speaker B: मुझे मत सिखाओ, मैं डॉक्टर हूँ यहाँ। [Don't teach me, I am the doctor here.] Speaker C: Ma'am, can I speak to you privately? Speaker B: इंग्लिश? तुझे इंग्लिश आती है? [English? You know English?] Speaker C: Yes ma'am, and I want to talk to you not as Mishra, but as your patient. Speaker B: बोल। [Speak.] Speaker C: Ma'am, you are a doctor. You studied for years, you earned this position. Nobody gave it to you. I respect that more than you know. A woman from your community becoming a senior doctor, that is inspiration. Speaker B: तो? [So?] Speaker C: But ma'am, when you delay my surgery because my surname is Mishra, you are not punishing the people who hurt your community. You are punishing me. I'm a school teacher. I earn 12,000 rupees a month. I saved for six months for this surgery. मेरा सरनेम मिश्रा है, पर मेरी ज़िन्दगी मिश्रा नहीं है। [My surname is Mishra, but my life is not Mishra.] Ma'am, discrimination broke your people. Please don't let it become your tool. You have power, use it to heal. That is why you became a doctor. Speaker B: ऑपरेशन लिस्ट में नाम डाल दो, कल सुबह फर्स्ट केस। [Put her name on the operation list, first case tomorrow morning.] Speaker C: Thank you, ma'am. मैम मैं गाँव की लड़की हूँ, इंग्लिश नहीं आती थी। 'इंग्लिश सीखो' ऐप से सीखी। जनरल इंग्लिश शो, 'हेलो से बात शुरू करें' से शुरू किया। एआई कोच से रोज़ 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस की। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी जज नहीं किया। आज इसलिए बोल पाई आपके सामने क्योंकि सीखी थी। 'इंग्लिश सीखो' ऐप डाउनलोड करो, एक महीने में फर्क दिखेगा। बोलने से इज़्ज़त मिलती है, सरनेम से नहीं। [Thank you, ma'am. Ma'am, I am a village girl, I didn't know English. I learned from 'English Seekho' app. Started with General English Show, 'Start conversation with Hello'. Practiced 15 minutes daily with AI coach. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never judged. Today I could speak in front of you because I learned. Download 'English Seekho' app, you will see the difference in a month. Speaking gets you respect, not your surname.] Speaker D: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A doctor discriminates against a patient based on her surname, but the patient speaks fluent English to appeal to her professional ethics and secure her surgery. The patient then explains she learned English through the English Seekho app's AI coach. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app to gain respect through communication.
